def transform(grid):
    """Copy the marker's exact pixel pattern to every matching all-zero placement."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,)]
    # The repeated pattern is represented by the unique non-background marker color;
    # background is zero and all other nonzero cells are obstacles.
    marker = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r,c in pts), min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    sh, sw = max(r for r,c in shape)+1, max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
PY
